_governance: COUNTED PROXY, NOT WALL-CLOCK (I2 design, wf_b9c32632-1fc journal; R304). Advance ONLY in a human-promoted commit. The gate reads this file at merge-base(master, HEAD), never the worktree, so a branch cannot lower its own bar (harness/verify/perf_ratchet.py::read_floor). Counts may FALL freely; they may only RISE via promotion carrying a per-cell _why or an unexpired waiver. PROPOSED means: measured by the R304 lane agent, NOT yet a floor — arming (REGISTRY.json ratchet.armed=true + human_armed_by) is a HUMAN gate (harness/latency/SPEC.md) and includes deny-listing this file in harness/agent-settings.json. A count is not a second: this file HOLDS the 98b556f/H10 win, it does not MEASURE one — seconds claims need Tier B (ratio) or Tier C (live).
_fidelity_limit: The counters measure the CALL PATTERN the bridge makes through the counting fakes (tests/perf_counters.py), not the cost pxr pays. The pxr-gated cross-check in tests/test_perf_ratchet.py is the only guard against fake/pxr drift and it SKIPS in CI.

pinned_constants._what: Count cells pin their OWN env (SYNAPSE_STAGE_HASH_*), so a change to a SHIPPED default would leave every cell green while changing production - exactly how the pre-98b556f 1<<62 default survived. These close that hole via an EQUALITY check in harness/verify/perf_ratchet.py::check_pinned_constants. Any change here is a promotion event. The two H10 volume constants were not in the I2 design (it predates f60b5b0) - same hole, same closure.
